name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-07-28, at wavelengths from 1.27 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
